item.title: Richer context for connected workouts
item.summary: Murph can now retain bounded cadence, power, heart-rate, split, distance, duration, and swimming features from supported workouts.
item.details: Workout context can now include compact heart-rate, cadence, power in watts, speed in meters per second, and split details for each connected workout. Murph does not retain coordinates, raw points, complete curves, or provider response arrays.
